annotation.evidence_span: Tokens obtained in Retry packets MUST NOT be discarded.
annotation.interpretation_a: The client MUST NOT discard tokens received in Retry packets, even if it wants to break identity continuity.
annotation.interpretation_b: The server MUST NOT discard tokens it sends in Retry packets.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify *who* must not discard the tokens. It could be interpreted as a requirement on the client (not discarding tokens it *receives* in Retry packets) or on the server (not discarding tokens it *sends* in Retry packets).
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether 'tokens' refers to tokens held by the client or the server. The clause could apply to either, leading to different implementations.
